name: Note
source:
A beautiful, expressionless homunculus.

"I don't know... There is no mistake about my objective, so why do I feel so lost?"

A doll-like girl who cooperates with Gran in performing the princess's training ritual. A "Homunculus" powered by a curse. She is indifferent and lacked the ability to express her emotions, but she wanted to talk about them in detail or pursue them when it came to things that interest her.

She possesses the power "Tool Creation." Allowing her to create and manipulate various tools with magical power.

Her main purpose is to fulfil the ritual, but "memories" other than the name and the ceremony were missing. The truth is shrouded in mystery...

[Translated from [url=https://www.escude.co.jp/product/testament/chara04.html]official website[/url]]
